title: croton pallens
intro: Croton pallens, commonly known as the "yellow senna" or "pallid croton", is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Croton pallens include its potential to treat diarrhea, dysentery, and other gastrointestinal issues due to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of Croton pallens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including anthraquinones, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
